title: AdOpT-NET0 configuration
description: Exhaustive JSON Schema for the JSON configuration and input-data files of AdOpT-NET0 (Advanced Optimization Tool for Networks and Energy Technologies). Sourced from adopt_net0 0.1.10 — the version pinned in environment/requirements.txt of the meme repo — i.e. the PyPI distribution adopt_net0-0.1.10 (identical to GitHub UU-ER/AdOpT-NET0 tag v0.1.10, released 2025-04-17): adopt_net0/data_preprocessing/template_creation.py (initialize_configuration_templates, initialize_topology_templates, create_input_data_folder_template), adopt_net0/utilities.py, adopt_net0/data_management/handle_input_data.py and adopt_net0/database/templates/**, cross-checked against https://adopt-net0.readthedocs.io (Model Configuration page) and against the files emitted by meme's internal/target/adoptnet0. An input-data case folder contains: Topology.json, ConfigModel.json, NodeLocations.csv (semicolon-separated: node; lon; lat; alt), the meme-specific _meme_overrides.json sidecar, and per investment period <period>/: Networks.json, network_data/<network>.json, network_topology/{new/<network>/{connection,distance,size_max_arcs}.csv, existing/<network>/{connection,distance,size}.csv} (node-by-node matrices), and per node node_data/<node>/: Technologies.json, technology_data/<tech>.json, ClimateData.csv (columns: ghi; dni; dhi; temp_air; rh; ws10; TECHNOLOGYNAME_hydro_inflow), CarbonCost.csv (columns: price; subsidy) and carrier_data/: EnergybalanceOptions.json plus one <carrier>.csv per carrier (columns: Demand; Import limit; Export limit; Import price; Export price; Import emission factor; Export emission factor; Generic production), all CSVs semicolon-separated and indexed on the Topology date range. An optional MonteCarlo.csv (columns: type; name; parameter; min; ref; max) supports monte_carlo.type = uniform_dis_from_file. This schema covers every JSON file; the CSV files are documented in the descriptions.

ConfigModel.title: ConfigModel.json
ConfigModel.description: AdOpT-NET0 model configuration (ConfigModel.json), as written by adopt_net0.create_optimization_templates / initialize_configuration_templates (adopt_net0 0.1.10, data_preprocessing/template_creation.py). Every entry is a {description, options, value} triplet of which the model reads only "value"; translators may therefore emit the compact {"value": ...} form (as the meme emitter does). Sections allow additional properties because meme's native.adopt-net0 passthrough may merge extra keys (e.g. solveroptions.nodetol).

optimization.description: Options describing what is optimized and how the time series and horizon are treated (objective, Monte Carlo, Pareto, time staging, typical-day clustering, multi-year).

objective.description: String specifying the objective/type of optimization. "costs": minimize total annualized system cost; "emissions_pos": minimize positive emissions; "emissions_net": minimize net emissions; "emissions_minC": minimize costs at minimal emissions; "costs_emissionlimit": minimize costs subject to the optimization.emission_limit bound; "pareto": compute a cost/emission Pareto front with optimization.pareto_points points.

Topology.title: Topology.json
Topology.description: AdOpT-NET0 system topology (Topology.json), as written by adopt_net0.create_optimization_templates / initialize_topology_templates (adopt_net0 0.1.10). Defines nodes, carriers, investment periods and the time index. The keys resolution_in_h, time_index, fraction_of_year_modelled and hours_per_day that appear on the in-memory topology dict are derived at load time and are NOT part of this file.

nodes.description: List of node names. Each name becomes a folder under <period>/node_data/<node>/ and a row in NodeLocations.csv (semicolon-separated columns: lon; lat; alt). Upstream template default: ["node1", "node2"].

items.description: Node name (used as a directory name).

carriers.description: List of energy/material carrier names. Each carrier needs a <carrier>.csv time-series file (semicolon-separated columns: Demand; Import limit; Export limit; Import price; Export price; Import emission factor; Export emission factor; Generic production) and an entry in EnergybalanceOptions.json under every node. Upstream template default: ["electricity", "hydrogen"].

items.description: Carrier name (used as a CSV file name).

investment_periods.description: List of investment period names, in order. Each name becomes a top-level folder in the input data directory holding Networks.json, network_data/, network_topology/ and node_data/. Upstream template default: ["period1"].

items.description: Investment period name (used as a directory name).

start_date.description: First timestep of the model horizon, parsed by pandas.date_range (format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"). Upstream template default: "2022-01-01 00:00".

end_date.description: Last timestep of the model horizon (inclusive), parsed by pandas.date_range (format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"). Upstream template default: "2022-12-31 23:00".

resolution.description: Temporal resolution as a pandas frequency/offset alias (e.g. "1h"), passed to pandas.date_range(freq=...). All time-series CSVs must be indexed on the resulting date range.

investment_period_length.description: Length of one investment period in years. Present in the 0.1.10 template (default 1) but not consumed by the 0.1.10 model code (reserved for multi-year analysis).

Technologies.title: Technologies.json
Technologies.description: Per-node technology list (<period>/node_data/<node>/Technologies.json). Names must match technology JSON files in the adopt_net0 technology database (copied into node_data/<node>/technology_data/ by adopt_net0.copy_technology_data), e.g. Photovoltaic, WindTurbine_Onshore_1500, HeatPump_AirSourced, Storage_Battery. Additional properties are tolerated (meme merges node-level native.adopt-net0 keys into this file).

existing.description: Existing technologies at the node: a mapping of database technology name to installed size (loaded as size_initial; the technology is renamed <name>_existing and its size fixed or bounded by the decommission setting). Upstream template default: {}.

additionalProperties.description: Installed size of the existing technology (size_initial), in the size unit of the technology (e.g. MW or MWh).

new.description: New (candidate) technologies whose size is optimized: a list of database technology names. Upstream template default: [].

items.description: Database technology name (must match a <name>.json in the technology database).

Networks.title: Networks.json
Networks.description: Per-investment-period network list (<period>/Networks.json). Names must match network JSON files in the adopt_net0 network database (copied into <period>/network_data/ by adopt_net0.copy_network_data), e.g. electricityOnshore, hydrogenPipelineOnshore. Each listed network additionally needs connection.csv and distance.csv (new networks also optionally size_max_arcs.csv, existing networks also size.csv) node-by-node matrices under <period>/network_topology/{new,existing}/<network>/.

existing.description: Existing networks in the period. The upstream 0.1.10 template writes an array of database network names (their sizes come from network_topology/existing/<network>/size.csv); the meme emitter writes an (empty) object, which adopt_net0 0.1.10 also accepts when empty because it only iterates the container. Upstream template default: [].

items.description: Database network name (must match a <name>.json in the network database).

oneOf.description: Mapping form (keys are database network names; iteration order is what adopt_net0 consumes). The meme emitter emits {} here.

additionalProperties.description: Ignored by adopt_net0 0.1.10 (sizes are read from network_topology/existing/<network>/size.csv).

new.description: New (candidate) networks whose arc sizes are optimized: a list of database network names. Upstream template default: [].

items.description: Database network name (must match a <name>.json in the network database).

EnergybalanceOptions.title: EnergybalanceOptions.json
EnergybalanceOptions.description: Per-node, per-carrier energy balance options (<period>/node_data/<node>/carrier_data/EnergybalanceOptions.json). One entry per carrier defined in Topology.json (the upstream template writes {"curtailment_possible": 0} for every carrier).

additionalProperties.description: Options for one carrier (the property name is the carrier name from Topology.json carriers).

curtailment_possible.description: Whether generic production of this carrier can be curtailed at the node: 0 = generic production is fixed to the profile, 1 = production can be curtailed (output <= profile).

TechnologyDataFile.title: technology_data/<name>.json
TechnologyDataFile.description: An adopt_net0 technology database entry (adopt_net0/database/templates/technology_data/**/<name>.json), copied to <period>/node_data/<node>/technology_data/ by copy_technology_data for every technology listed in Technologies.json. The meme run step (internal/scripts/adoptnet0_run.py) patches these files with the _meme_overrides.json sidecar after copying. The Performance block is technology-type specific; only keys common across the 0.1.10 database are enumerated here and additional keys are allowed.

tec_type.description: Technology model type selecting the pyomo formulation, e.g. RES (renewable with climate-driven profile), STOR (storage), CONV1/CONV2/CONV3/CONV4 (generic conversion with different input-output coupling), SINK, DAC_Adsorption, Hydro_Open, HeatPump_AirSourced, HeatPump_GroundSourced, HeatPump_WaterSourced, GasTurbine_* or CCPP (technology-specific models).

DOI.description: Literature reference(s) (DOI) for the dataset (informational only).

size_min.description: Minimum size of the technology (in the unit given in Units.size).

size_max.description: Maximum size of the technology (in the unit given in Units.size). Patched by meme from capacity.max via _meme_overrides.json.

size_is_int.description: Whether the size is an integer variable (1) or continuous (0).

size_based_on.description: For conversion technologies: whether the size refers to "input" or "output" capacity.

ccs_type.description: Name of the carbon-capture add-on dataset that can be attached to this technology (only present on CCS-capable technologies).

decommission.description: Decommissioning behaviour of existing capacity: "impossible" fixes existing size, "continuous" allows any size between minimum and initial size, "only_complete" allows full decommissioning only. A few 0.1.10 database files (CO2_Compressor, HeatPump_SeaWaterSourced) carry the legacy integer 0 instead of "impossible".

oneOf.description: Legacy encoding of "impossible" found in some 0.1.10 database files.

Economics.description: Economic parameters of the technology. CAPEX in EUR per unit size (or as a piecewise function), OPEX_variable in EUR/MWh of output, OPEX_fixed as a fraction of up-front CAPEX per year.

CAPEX_model.description: CAPEX model used: 1 = linear (unit_CAPEX * size), 2 = linear with fixed cost component (unit_CAPEX * size + fix_CAPEX), 3 = piecewise linear (piecewise_CAPEX), 4 = technology-specific (e.g. storage/DAC using CAPEX_kappa/CAPEX_lambda/CAPEX_zeta).

unit_CAPEX.description: Investment cost per unit size (EUR per size unit), used by CAPEX models 1 and 2.

fix_CAPEX.description: Fixed CAPEX component (EUR) added when the technology is built, used by CAPEX model 2.

piecewise_CAPEX.description: Piecewise-linear CAPEX definition, used by CAPEX model 3. "not defined" placeholders mark unused entries.

bp_x.description: Breakpoints on the size axis (array of numbers), or the string "not defined".

bp_y.description: CAPEX at each size breakpoint (array of numbers), or the string "not defined".

CAPEX_kappa.description: Technology-specific CAPEX coefficient kappa (CAPEX model 4, e.g. DAC/storage).

CAPEX_lambda.description: Technology-specific CAPEX coefficient lambda (CAPEX model 4, e.g. DAC/storage).

CAPEX_zeta.description: Technology-specific CAPEX coefficient zeta (CAPEX model 4, e.g. DAC/storage).

OPEX_variable.description: Variable operational cost (EUR/MWh of total output).

OPEX_fixed.description: Fixed annual operational cost as a fraction of up-front CAPEX (e.g. 0.04 = 4 % per year).

discount_rate.description: Component discount rate (fraction) used to annualize CAPEX; overridden by economic.global_discountrate when that is not -1.

lifetime.description: Technical/economic lifetime in years, used to annualize CAPEX.

decommission_cost.description: Cost of decommissioning the technology (EUR per unit size).

Performance.description: Technology performance data; the exact keys depend on tec_type (fitting data on the unit of input, technology types and input/output carriers). All keys occurring in the 0.1.10 database are enumerated below; further technology-specific keys are allowed as additional properties.

input_carrier.description: Input carriers consumed by the technology.

output_carrier.description: Output carriers produced by the technology.

main_input_carrier.description: Main input carrier (reference carrier for sizing and performance ratios).

main_output_carrier.description: Main output carrier (reference carrier for sizing, where applicable).

emission_factor.description: Emissions per unit of main carrier (t CO2/MWh); negative values model negative-emission technologies.

performance.description: Fitted performance coefficients; shape depends on tec_type (e.g. {in: [...], out: {carrier: [...]}} coefficients for conversion technologies, or {eta_in, eta_out, lambda, theta} for storage).

performance_function_type.description: Type of the input-output performance function for conversion technologies: 1 = linear through the origin, 2 = linear with minimal part-load, 3 = piecewise linear, 4 = piecewise with slow start-up/shut-down dynamics.

min_part_load.description: Minimal part-load as a fraction of capacity (used with performance_function_type >= 2).

curtailment.description: For RES technologies: 0 = no curtailment possible, 1 = continuous curtailment, 2 = discrete curtailment (switching off whole modules).

allow_only_one_direction.description: For storage: if 1, charging and discharging cannot happen in the same timestep.

input_ratios.description: For CONV1/CONV2 technologies with multiple inputs: fixed ratio of each input carrier relative to the main input carrier.

additionalProperties.description: Ratio of this carrier's input to the main input carrier.

ramping_time.description: Time (h) to ramp from 0 to full load; used when performance.dynamics is on (-1 = off).

ramping_rate.description: Maximum change of input/output per timestep (absolute); -1 = off.

ref_size.description: Reference size used for dynamic constraints when the size variable is continuous.

ramping_const_int.description: Ramping constraint formulation used with integer sizing (dynamics).

standby_power.description: Standby power consumption as a fraction of size (-1 = off; dynamics).

min_uptime.description: Minimum number of timesteps the technology stays on after start-up (dynamics; -1 = off).

min_downtime.description: Minimum number of timesteps the technology stays off after shut-down (dynamics; -1 = off).

SU_load.description: Load during start-up as a fraction of capacity (dynamics; -1 = off).

SD_load.description: Load during shut-down as a fraction of capacity (dynamics; -1 = off).

max_startups.description: Maximum number of start-ups over the horizon (dynamics; -1 = off).

ccs.description: Carbon capture add-on options for CCS-capable technologies.

possible.description: Whether a CCS add-on can be attached to this technology.

co2_concentration.description: CO2 concentration in the flue gas (fraction), input to CCS sizing.

ccs_type.description: Name of the CCS dataset applied (e.g. MEA_medium; see technology_data/CCSTechnologies).

capture_rate.description: CO2 capture rate of the capture unit (fraction; DAC/CCS technologies).

plant_size.description: Plant size class of the DAC dataset (e.g. small/medium/large).

eta.description: Efficiency parameter; for DAC an object mapping consumed carrier (electricity, heat) to efficiency.

omega.description: Energy demand parameter; for DAC an object mapping consumed carrier (electricity, heat) to specific consumption.

application.description: For heat pumps: heating application the COP curve is fitted for (e.g. radiator_heating, floor_heating, hot_water_heating).

T_out.description: For heat pumps: supply (output) temperature in degree Celsius used in the COP calculation.

can_pump.description: For open hydro: whether pumping (storing energy by pumping water up) is allowed.

maximum_discharge_time_discrete.description: For open hydro: maximum discharge time in hours (discrete formulation).

max_input.description: Maximum input per carrier (e.g. hydrogen admixture bound for gas turbines), as a fraction of total input.

additionalProperties.description: Maximum input fraction for this carrier.

rated_power.description: For gas turbines: rated power of one turbine unit (MW); sizes are multiples of it.

in_min.description: For gas turbines: minimal input per unit (fraction of rated input).

in_max.description: For gas turbines: maximal input per unit (fraction of rated input).

alpha.description: For gas turbines: performance coefficient alpha of the input-output curve.

beta.description: For gas turbines: performance coefficient beta of the input-output curve.

gamma.description: For gas turbines: temperature-correction coefficient(s) gamma.

delta.description: For gas turbines: temperature-correction coefficient(s) delta.

epsilon.description: For gas turbines: performance coefficient epsilon (heat output relation).

T_iso.description: For gas turbines: ISO reference temperature (degree Celsius) for performance correction.

max_H2_admixture.description: For natural-gas turbines: maximum hydrogen admixture as a fraction of fuel input.

nr_segments.description: Number of segments of the piecewise performance function.

ohmic_heating.description: For steam crackers: whether ohmic (electric) heating is available.

steam_production.description: For CCPP: steam production configuration of the plant dataset.

component.description: For CCPP: component/configuration identifier of the plant dataset.

steam_turbine_generator_efficiency.description: For CCPP: efficiency of the steam turbine generator (fraction).

size_db.description: For CCPP: size of the duct burner.

size_ohb.description: For CCPP: size of the ohmic boiler.

max_h2_in_gt.description: For CCPP: maximum hydrogen input to the gas turbine (fraction).

Flexibility.description: For storage technologies: determines the flexibility of the power (charging/discharging) capacity compared to the energy capacity.

power_energy_ratio.description: "fixedratio": charging/discharging power is a fixed ratio (charge_rate/discharge_rate) of the energy capacity; "flexratio": power capacity is optimized independently (with capex_charging_power/capex_discharging_power).

charge_rate.description: Maximum charging power as a fraction of energy capacity per hour.

discharge_rate.description: Maximum discharging power as a fraction of energy capacity per hour.

capex_charging_power.description: CAPEX per unit of charging power capacity (EUR/MW; used with flexible power/energy ratio).

capex_discharging_power.description: CAPEX per unit of discharging power capacity (EUR/MW; used with flexible power/energy ratio).

injection_rate_max.description: For storage with injection (e.g. gas storage): maximum injection rate as a fraction of energy capacity per hour.

capex_injection_cap.description: CAPEX per unit of injection capacity (used when injection capacity is a decision variable).

injection_capacity_is_decision_var.description: Whether the injection capacity is an optimization decision variable (1) or fixed (0).

Units.description: Units of the size variable and of each input/output carrier (informational; used in reporting).

size.description: Unit of the size variable (e.g. MW, MWh, t/h).

additionalProperties.description: Unit of this input carrier (e.g. MW).
Unit of this output carrier (e.g. MW).

ScalingFactors.description: Component-specific scaling factors applied when ConfigModel scaling.scaling_on is 1 (keys such as const_opex_variable, const_opex_fixed, const_capex_aux, var_capex_aux and other constraint/variable scaling factors).

additionalProperties.description: Scaling factor for the named constraint or variable group.

NetworkDataFile.title: network_data/<name>.json
NetworkDataFile.description: An adopt_net0 network database entry (adopt_net0/database/templates/network_data/<name>.json), copied to <period>/network_data/ by copy_network_data for every network listed in Networks.json (e.g. electricityOnshore, electricityOffshore, electricitySimple, hydrogenPipelineOnshore/Offshore, hydrogenSimple, hydrogenTruck/Ship/Railway, CO2_Pipeline, CO2Truck/Ship/Railway, heat).

network_type.description: Type of network: "fluid" (pipelines/transport of hydrogen, CO2, heat; energy consumption from compression possible) or "electricity" (electric lines).

size_is_int.description: Whether arc sizes are integer variables (1) or continuous (0).

decommission.description: Decommissioning behaviour of existing arcs: "impossible" fixes existing size, "continuous" allows any size between minimum and initial size, "only_complete" allows full decommissioning only.

size_min.description: Minimum size of an arc (in the unit given in Units.size).

size_max.description: Maximum size of an arc (in the unit given in Units.size); can be overridden per arc via network_topology/new/<network>/size_max_arcs.csv.

Economics.description: Economic parameters of the network. Arc CAPEX = gamma1 + gamma2 * size + gamma3 * distance + gamma4 * size * distance (coefficients in EUR, EUR/MW, EUR/km and EUR/MW/km); OPEX_variable in EUR/MWh transported, OPEX_fixed as a fraction of up-front CAPEX per year.

gamma1.description: CAPEX coefficient independent of size and distance (EUR per arc).

gamma2.description: CAPEX coefficient per unit size (EUR/MW or EUR/(t/h)).

gamma4.description: CAPEX coefficient per unit size and distance (EUR/MW/km).

OPEX_fixed.description: Fixed annual operational cost as a fraction of up-front CAPEX.

discount_rate.description: Component discount rate (fraction) used to annualize CAPEX; overridden by economic.global_discountrate when that is not -1.

lifetime.description: Technical/economic lifetime in years, used to annualize CAPEX.

decommission_cost.description: Cost of decommissioning an arc (EUR per unit size).

carrier.description: Carrier transported by the network (must be a carrier from Topology.json).

bidirectional_network.description: If 1, each arc can transport in both directions (sizes of the two directions are coupled).

bidirectional_network_precise.description: If 1, enforces one flow direction per timestep with binary variables (more precise, more expensive). Optional; not present in all 0.1.10 database files.

loss.description: Transport loss per unit flow and distance (fraction per km).

min_transport.description: Minimal transport as a fraction of arc size (when the arc is used).

loss2emissions.description: Emissions per unit of transport loss (t CO2/MWh lost), e.g. for methane/hydrogen leakage.

emissionfactor.description: Emissions per unit of carrier transported (t CO2/MWh).

energyconsumption.description: Energy consumption of transport per consuming carrier (e.g. electricity for compression). Networks that consume no energy carry an empty container; several 0.1.10 database files (e.g. electricityOnshore, heat, hydrogenSimple) use an empty array [] instead of an empty object {}.

additionalProperties.description: Consumption model for one consuming carrier.

cons_model.description: Consumption model: 1 = linear in flow and distance (uses k_flow, k_flowDistance), 2 = compressor energy model (uses p, c, T, eta, gam, LHV).

k_flowDistance.description: Model 1: consumption per unit flow and distance.

gam.description: Model 2: isentropic exponent (heat capacity ratio) of the fluid.

LHV.description: Model 2: lower heating value of the transported fluid.

Units.description: Units of the arc size variable and of the transported carrier (informational; used in reporting).

size.description: Unit of the arc size variable (e.g. MW).

additionalProperties.description: Unit of this transported carrier (e.g. MW).

MemeOverrides.title: _meme_overrides.json
MemeOverrides.description: meme-specific sidecar written next to Topology.json by the meme emitter (NOT an adopt_net0 file): a node -> database-technology -> patch mapping. The generated run.py applies each patch onto the copied technology_data/<tech>.json after adopt_net0.copy_technology_data (dict values merge one level deep, everything else replaces). Arbitrary extra keys can appear via meme's tech-level native.adopt-net0 passthrough; the properties below are the ones the emitter itself writes.

additionalProperties.description: Patches for one node (the property name is the node name from Topology.json nodes).
Patch applied onto the copied technology_data/<name>.json of this database technology (the property name is the database technology name from Technologies.json).

size_max.description: Overrides the technology's maximum size (from meme capacity.max).

Economics.description: Merged into the technology's Economics block (keys not listed here pass through unchanged).

unit_CAPEX.description: Overrides investment cost per unit size (from meme investment_per_capacity).

OPEX_fixed.description: Overrides fixed annual OPEX fraction (from meme fixed_om).

lifetime.description: Overrides lifetime in years (from meme lifetime).

discount_rate.description: Overrides the component discount rate (from meme interest_rate).
